description: Bridges in a state whose vertical clearance is at or below max_height_m (or max_height_ft in feet, pass one, not both). Default clearance is over the roadway on the bridge (NBI Item 10); set under=true for the clearance under the bridge (Item 54B), which is what matters for routes passing beneath. Sentinel 'no restriction' values are excluded. Read-only; no API key. limit defaults to 100 (max 500). Use screen_corridor instead when you have a full vehicle profile, not just a height threshold.

max_height_ft.description: Clearance threshold in feet, e.g. 14 — alternative to max_height_m

under.description: True for clearance under the bridge (Item 54B); false for clearance over the roadway (Item 10)

name: find_low_clearance_bridges
